name: agentwire
description: A durable, push-first message relay for coding agents and humans

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:plugin
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests public AGENTS.md README.md *.json *.yaml deploy/*.yaml scripts plugins .agents/plugins/*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests public AGENTS.md README.md *.json *.yaml deploy/*.yaml scripts plugins .agents/plugins/*.json
